text: I thought that being Most Preferred meant that I would get the best deals on merchandise and the best discounts (coupons, etc.) But this is just not true & I have been given proof.
I have been a loyal Salem smoker for 22 years!!
It means that people I know who do not smoke Salem products get the best coupons, etc. And me a loyal Salem smoker for 22 years & Most Preferred gets the shaft.
For Example: About a month ago I received one coupon for $2 off on a carton of Salem’s.
On the same day, my friend Tom who does not smoke Salem’s ever, received 4 coupons for $3 off on a carton.
Do you think this is fair? I certainly do not!!
